title: Great app
body:
I like this app. Beautiful interface, looks nice. Very useful for monitoring and keeping track of my good habits.
I love this app. I'm really happy with the free version, but I decided to purchase the full version to support the developers. I use the app multiple times every day.
author: KellR

title: Has potential
body: But notifications doesn't work, making it useless as you can't get reminders.
author: peewee1233

title: Elegant and Useful
body: This app is aesthetically pleasing to use, whilst also giving you a great variety of options for customising how you track habits or chores. Worth purchasing the full version too. Would recommend.
author: cjgardnerhomes
